subject: Repooling request: convert SDE2 backfill to SDE3 for Search Infra
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to re-pool headcount: convert SDE2 backfill to SDE3 (Search Infra)

Hi Neha / Aditya / Lauren,

We have a SDE2 headcount open on the Search Infra team (vacated due to an internal transfer to Product Infra). Over the last quarter the scope of that role shifted: the engineer will now own the query routing rewrite and a higher percentage of low-latency kernel work. After interviewing a few contractors and reviewing upcoming milestones, I believe this vacancy should be reclassified as SDE3 to reflect the technical scope and to be market-competitive.

Proposal summary:
- Convert the existing SDE2 backfill to an SDE3 role (same headcount slot, re-pooled).
- Proposed job title: Software Engineer III, Search Infra.
- Reason: increased ownership of cross-service routing, critical on-call rotations, mentoring expected for two new hires.
- Budget: increase base band midpoint by ~12% vs original SDE2 slot. I have a short compensation proposal attached.

Ask: Can People Ops approve a relevel for this backfill or advise an alternate path (promotion vs new hire) for headcount + comp? Also copying Recruiting to flag urgency — we would like to start interviews in two weeks to hit Q1 deliverables.

Attachments: org_delta_headcount.xlsx (headcount sheet)

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Engineering Manager, Search
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to re-pool headcount: convert SDE2 backfill to SDE3 (Search Infra)

Thanks Maya — received. A few follow-ups before People Ops can sign off:
1) Formal justification (one pager) listing duties that exceed SDE2 expectations.
2) Proposed comp band (base min/mid/max) for SDE3 in region and whether total comp delta fits an existing budget line.
3) Confirmation of source for the additional cost (e.g., repool from contracting bucket, transfer from non-critical reqs, or additional headcount request).

If you can send that by EOD Wednesday, I’ll route for expedited review and loop in Finance if we need a budget reallocation.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T14:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to re-pool headcount: convert SDE2 backfill to SDE3 (Search Infra)

Neha — thanks. Short justification attached (comp_band_proposal.pdf). Key points: 
- Scope increase: owner of the query routing rewrite (service-wide impact), lead on the latency-regression response playbook, and expected to mentor two new SDE1 hires. These are routinely SDE3 responsibilities at comparative teams.
- Proposed US comp band (base): min $160,000 / mid $190,000 / max $220,000; target total comp delta vs original slot ~+12–15% depending on equity.
- Proposed funding: repool from one open contractor slot in infra (contractor currently budgeted at $120k annual; converting and repricing to FTE SDE3 fits within the team’s committed spend with partial top-up). I attached the headcount sheet showing the contract line we can retire.

Recruiting note: I’ve drafted a GH job (link below) that targets immediate sourcing for senior ICs with latency + systems experience. If internal promotion candidates exist, I’m open to that route but we need comp guidance either way.

Links: https://greenhouse.hiring/jobs/12345-draft
Attachments: comp_band_proposal.pdf, org_delta_headcount.xlsx

-Maya
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@tide-recruit.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to re-pool headcount: convert SDE2 backfill to SDE3 (Search Infra)

Thanks Maya — good write-up. A few practical notes from recruiting:
- Market for low-latency infra with kernel/hotpath experience is tight; SDE3 band you propose is consistent with recent comps we’ve seen in Bay Area and remote US hires.
- We have a bench of two potential internal transferees who could be short-listed; if you prefer internal promotion that often accelerates start date and reduces comp premium.
- If we go external, expect 4–6 weeks to offer stage. To speed this, we can enable a fast-track loop if People Ops signs off on comp+band adjustment and manager approves hiring via the headcount queue.

Attaching a quick bench extract (bench_candidates.csv) with names + internal performance notes. Also looping Morgan at Tide to confirm they can prioritize senior search infra candidates if we go external.

-Lauren
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T16:34:00-08:00
Subject: Approval path and conditions for SDE3 relevel (Search Infra)

Maya / Lauren — following review, People Ops is provisionally supportive of converting the SDE2 backfill to an SDE3 with the proposed band, pending two items:
1) Director sign-off confirming the business necessity and that the incremental cost will be absorbed via the contractor repool (Marcus, can you confirm?)
2) Updated compensation breakdown showing base, target total comp, and equity estimate for the role (please add to the GH job draft).

Next steps:
- Maya: add the comp breakdown to the GH draft and upload an updated org chart to the Drive link.
- Marcus: please reply-all with sign-off (or counter proposal) by EOD Thu so Recruiting can start fast-track sourcing.

When both items are in place People Ops will route the relevel through headcount-approvals@redwood.com for final budget change and update the headcount register. Target SLA for final approval is 72 hours after director sign-off.

-Neha
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference
